title: 第21章 卖虎皮第22章 三代世家
content_zh:
;;
清江县城，西市。
许明巍执缰徐行，唇角噙着三分洞悉世情的笑。
青石板道上马蹄声碎如更漏，四周熙熙攘攘，有酒铺的吆喝声，胭脂铺前的铜秤晃铛，亦有茶寮里碎银落盘的脆响。
“阿爹说的果然没错。”
“天下熙熙，皆为利来，天下攘攘，皆为利往。”
“人多了，需求多了，便会自然而然衍生各种各样的行当。”
“这西市多的是摊贩，小铺，但所有利润加起来，或许要超出东市各大商铺的利润。”
俄尔。
许明巍就到了许明渊暂居的云来客栈。
刚走到客栈门口，就见许明渊，周鸣，赵大龙等人朝外走来。
“阿渊。”
许明巍突然喊道。
正在叮嘱周鸣的许明渊微微愣神，转头看去，脸上顿时露出笑容，“大哥。”
几人快步走过去。
“大哥，你怎么来了。”
“大公子。”周鸣等人都是躬身问候。
许明巍点点头，笑道：“昨日进山，有些收获，来卖皮子，阿爹说卖掉的皮子钱给你。”
“我想着清江县你熟，所以先来找你。”
“那你可找对了，这几年在县城，我还是积累到一些人脉的。”许明渊哈哈一笑，“如果直接去当铺或者其它地方，卖不出太高的价。”

“周先生，你们先按照之前商议的去做的，我先陪我大哥办点事。”
“好的，二公子。”
周鸣带着赵大龙等人直接离去。
许明渊道：“大哥，我们边走边说吧，这次又猎到什么好皮子了？”
“是青狼的，还是花豹的，或者又是银狐？”
“自己看吧。”许明巍打开包袱让许明渊看了会。
“这颜色，猛虎啊？！”
“皮毛质地不错，有无破损？如此鼓应该不止一张皮子吧？”
“两张，一雄一雌，夫妻俩，雄虎的足有半丈的身高，重逾千斤，雌的略小，但也比普通老虎要健硕。”许明巍详细说道，“它们还有一只幼崽，带回家给雪霁当玩伴了。”
“额，拿老虎幼崽当玩伴？”许明渊微微吃惊，一般人都不会有这胆子吧。
毕竟成长起来，寻常武者根本对付不了。
如果一不小心，就连一流武者都会被重创。
“阿爹允许的，说雪霁养无甚问题。”
“好吧，阿爹说的应该没错。”
许明渊略一琢磨，便不再纠结这个问题。
content_en:

Qingjiang County, West City.
Xu Mingwei held the reins and walked slowly, with a smile on his lips that showed a deep understanding of the world.
The sound of horse hooves on the bluestone pavement was as loud as the sound of a clock, and the surroundings were bustling with people. There were shouts from the wine shop, the copper scales in front of the rouge shop jingled, and there was also the crisp sound of broken silver falling onto the plate in the teahouse.
"What dad said is indeed right."
"The bustle in the world is all for the sake of coming, and the hustle and bustle of the world is all for the sake of going."
“With more people and more needs, various businesses will naturally emerge.”
"There are many vendors and shops in the West Market, but the total profits may exceed the profits of the major shops in the East Market."
Er.
Xu Mingwei arrived at the Yunlai Inn where Xu Mingyuan lived temporarily.
As soon as I walked to the door of the inn, I saw Xu Mingyuan, Zhou Ming, Zhao Dalong and others walking out.
"Ayuan."
Xu Mingwei suddenly shouted.
Xu Mingyuan, who was admonishing Zhou Ming, was slightly stunned. He turned around and looked with a smile on his face, "Brother."
Several people walked over quickly.
"Brother, why are you here?"
"Young Master." Zhou Ming and others bowed in greeting.
Xu Mingwei nodded and said with a smile: "I went into the mountains yesterday and harvested some skins. I came here to sell the skins. Dad said I would give you the money for the skins."
"I thought you were familiar with Qingjiang County, so I came to see you first."
"Then you are looking for the right one. I have accumulated some connections in the county over the past few years." Xu Mingyuan laughed, "If you go directly to a pawn shop or other places, you won't be able to sell it at a high price."
"Mr. Zhou, you should do as you agreed before. I will accompany my elder brother to do some errands first."
"Okay, Second Young Master."
Zhou Ming took Zhao Dalong and others and left directly.
Xu Mingyuan said: "Brother, let's talk as we walk. What good skin did we hunt this time?"
"Is it the green wolf's, the leopard's, or the silver fox's?"
"See for yourself." Xu Mingwei opened the bag and let Xu Mingyuan look at it for a while.
"This color, is it a tiger?!"
"The texture of the fur is good. Is it damaged? There should be more than one piece of skin like this, right?"
"Two pictures, one male and one female, a couple. The male tiger is half a foot tall and weighs more than a thousand kilograms. The female is slightly smaller, but stronger than ordinary tigers." Xu Mingwei said in detail, "They also have a cub, which they brought home to be Xue Ji's playmate."
"Um, using a tiger cub as a playmate?" Xu Mingyuan was slightly surprised. Most people wouldn't have such courage.
After all, when he grows up, ordinary warriors cannot deal with him.
If you are not careful, even a first-rate warrior will be severely injured.
"My dad gave me permission and said there would be no problem raising Xue Ji."
"Okay, daddy must be right."
Xu Mingyuan thought about it for a moment and stopped worrying about this issue.
